chapter: Royal Roost, Birdland and Three O'Clock High
title: House quartet at Birdland with Billy Taylor; Sarah Vaughan
summary: Collins was in the Birdland house group with Billy Taylor, Al McKibbon and Jo Jones, and first worked with Sarah Vaughan there.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah, a little later. And then I went into Birdland with Billy Taylor. We had a group, a quartet. Billy Taylor, Al McKibben, Jo Jones and myself. And we were like the house group, and I would -- oh, if another group came in and didn't have guitars or something I would play with them. And this was the first time I worked with Sarah, because she came in with Jimmy Jones, and so they used our rhythm section, everybody but Billy Taylor. And we just cooked, we had a ball, it was just beautiful.
And I worked there with -- I worked there with Art Tatum, I worked at Birdland with Art Tatum.
You were with Art Tatum at different --
Yes, different times. Matter of fact when I joined --
first was in Chicago for two years.
